relevant_findings.finding: Built-in millwork uses Opening Count quantification method for interior compartments
relevant_findings.impact: Primary UOM is EA (openings by tier S/M/L/XL). Avoids complex SF/LF measurement of variable shelf geometry. Three modifiers (depth, detail, access) capture complexity without changing the count.

relevant_findings.finding: Built-ins with doors/drawers require removal for flat painting on sawhorses
relevant_findings.impact: Separate ITM_BUILTIN_DOOR paintable item (EA). Doors painted flat for gravity-assisted leveling. 5-7 day cure for waterborne alkyd (QT4+) before closing doors -- premature closing causes finish fusion.

relevant_findings.finding: NC built-in substrates are factory-primed MDF or bare wood (MDF, FJP, softwood)
relevant_findings.impact: Substrate state drives primer task: SS_BARE requires full primer (substrate-driven chemistry), SS_PRIMED_FACTORY skips primer. MDF edges require solvent-based sealer to prevent fiber raise -- step 1 of two-step prime.

relevant_findings.finding: Built-ins are prominent millwork -- QT2 is prohibited
relevant_findings.impact: QT3 is minimum quality tier. Built-ins are visible, inspected millwork surfaces that require production discipline.

relevant_findings.finding: Fine Finish workflow governs all built-in painting
relevant_findings.impact: Standard module sequence: SETUP > INITIAL_PREP > PRIME (conditional) > INTERSTAGE > FINISH_COAT_1 > INTERSTAGE > FINISH_COAT_2 > FINAL_INSPECT > CLEANUP. Interstage runs after each coat except final.

relevant_findings.finding: Face frame and exterior surface complexity captured by DETAIL modifier, not separate items
relevant_findings.impact: FACE_FRAME adds face frame edges/rails/stiles to opening rate. CROWN_VALANCE adds decorative top details. BEADED_ROUTED adds profile complexity. Optional separate exterior PS keys (BUILTIN_END_PANEL, BUILTIN_FACEFRAME, BUILTIN_TOP) are available if production accuracy demands but not required for v1.

relevant_findings.finding: Hardware removal and reinstallation is a distinct labor task
relevant_findings.impact: PS_META.EA.BUILTIN_HARDWARE drives hardware removal/reinstall tasks. Remove all hardware (hinges, knobs, pulls, catches) before coating.

relevant_findings.finding: Spray preferred for complex built-in interiors; brush viable with rigid-block sanding strategy
relevant_findings.impact: Spray reaches all interior surfaces uniformly. Brush requires rigid-block sanding between coats (mandatory doctrine). QT5 brush may need 3+ coats where spray needs 2. The 2-minute window for waterborne products is critical -- apply, tip once, walk away.

relevant_findings.finding: Built-ins are the SOURCE of complexity modifier on adjacent wall/ceiling specs
relevant_findings.impact: This spec does not receive a COMP_ modifier from itself. Adjacent specs (wall, ceiling) receive complexity modifier when built-ins are present in the room. No COMP_BUILTIN exists yet -- may need proposal.

condition_drivers.effect: SS_BARE requires primer coat + heavier prep (full sand, MDF edge seal). SS_PRIMED_FACTORY skips primer, lighter prep (scuff sand only).
Spray preferred for production and complex interiors. Brush for occupied spaces, small scope, or limited spray access. Spray activates floor_workzone and wall_adjacent protection zones.
QT3=standard production (1.0x). QT4=premium, full sand, systematic inspect (1.30x). QT5=superior, thorough sand, critical inspect, 3+ coats brush (1.50x). Sheen/QT gate enforced.
Depth increases labor for reach, masking difficulty, and edge work. PaintScope-provided modifier.
Profile complexity affects production rate. SIMPLE_BOX=baseline. FACE_FRAME adds stiles/rails. CROWN_VALANCE adds decorative top. BEADED_ROUTED adds detailed profiles.
Workspace restrictions affect production rate. CRAMPED=tight closet or hallway. OBSTRUCTED=permanent obstacles.
When true, activates door/drawer removal, flat painting, hardware removal, and reinstallation tasks. Glass doors excluded (not painted).

quality_differences.description: Standard quality. Even coverage, light imperfections acceptable at 39" inspection. 2 finish coats. Spot sand between coats only if necessary. Pinholes may be left during fill.
Premium quality. Smooth finish, systematic scan at 3 feet. 2 finish coats with full sanding between. All visible holes filled. Crisp caulk lines.
Superior quality. Near-flawless, lighted critical inspection at arm's length. 2-3 finish coats (3 if brush). Every hole filled regardless of size. Perfect tooled caulk.
quality_differences.condition_gate: QT5 modifier (1.5x) applies ONLY to Good condition. Fair/Poor = hourly (QT6).

failure_modes.cause: Water-based primer applied directly to unsealed MDF edge
failure_modes.prevention: Solvent-based edge sealer BEFORE latex primer (two-step prime per Millwork Doctrine SS4)

failure_modes.cause: Doors closed before waterborne alkyd fully cured (< 5-7 days)
failure_modes.prevention: Minimum 5-7 day cure before closing doors per FFD SS15.11.3. Keep doors propped open during cure.

failure_modes.cause: Finger-joint pine resin not adequately blocked before finish coats
failure_modes.prevention: Stain-blocking primer (Zinsser BIN / Kilz Original) on FJP substrate per Millwork Doctrine SS4

failure_modes.mode: Brush marks on flat built-in surfaces
failure_modes.cause: Re-brushing waterborne product after 2-3 minute window, or using flexible sanding block
failure_modes.prevention: Apply, tip once, walk away (2-minute window per FFD SS15.7.1). Rigid-block sanding between coats. Build finish through multiple sanded coats.

failure_modes.cause: Over-application on vertical surfaces inside deep openings
failure_modes.prevention: Light coats, proper technique, good lighting inside compartments. DEEP and VERY_DEEP modifiers account for slower pace.

failure_modes.mode: Poor primer adhesion on factory-primed surface
failure_modes.cause: Factory primer too thin or contaminated
failure_modes.prevention: Inspect factory primer during prep. If damaged or suspect, treat as SS_BARE (full prime). Standard scuff sand provides adhesion for intact primer.

notes_for_materials_manager: MDF edge sealer required for SS_BARE MDF -- solvent-based (BIN, Kilz Original)
QT-driven finish systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC (QT3), SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE (QT4), SYS_FF_PREMIUM (QT5) -- all reuse existing IDs
Primer selection substrate-driven per Millwork Doctrine SS4: MDF=two-step (edge seal + latex build), FJP=stain-blocking, softwood=standard acrylic, factory-primed=optional
Masking materials: 72" pre-taped film for standard built-ins, 99" for floor-to-ceiling units (Protection_and_Masking_Doctrine)
Yellow delicate-surface tape for built-in edges and fresh paint -- longer duration safe
Spackle usage higher in NC: overfill/sand method for fastener holes, 3-5x standard per Millwork Doctrine
Caulk at built-in-to-wall junctions: ~72 LF/tube NC rate
RC-005: Material systems are suggestions per QT -- contractor has discretion
RC-006: Both Advance and Emerald Urethane have SHORT working times (not long open time)
notes_for_sop_librarian: Use Opening Count (EA by tier) as quantity driver for carcass painting tasks
Separate task chain for door/drawer fronts: remove > paint flat > cure > reinstall
Hardware removal/reinstall as separate FIXED tasks (binary, not qt_scaled)
MDF edge seal task conditional on substrate_state = SS_BARE AND substrate_type includes MDF
Application method task variants: spray (carcass + doors), brush (carcass + doors)
Interstage after each coat except final: 2 runs for prime+2finish, 1 run for 2finish-only
Floor protection and wall masking are per-room FIXED tasks (room setup)
Keep module structure parallel to closet shelf but with additional door/hardware modules
5-7 day cure note goes in door reinstallation task as constraint, not as a separate task
notes_for_estimation_engineer: Opening-based rates (EA/hr) vary by tier: S=fastest, XL=slowest per EA
PaintScope modifiers DEPTH, DETAIL, ACCESS multiply production time (not rate)
Height modifier (H1-H4) for tall units -- floor-to-ceiling bookcases may be H2
QT modifiers per Modifier_Registry.md: QT3=1.0x, QT4=1.30x, QT5=1.50x
Door/drawer front rates similar to door slab rates (EA/hr) -- painted flat on sawhorses
No COMP_BUILTIN modifier on this spec -- it causes complexity on adjacent specs, not itself
Spray rates faster than brush for both carcass and door work
Modifier stacking: total = height x depth x detail x access x QT (multiply, not add). Flag if > 4.0x.
Reference Millwork Doctrine SS7.1 for LF-based trim rates, adapt for opening EA rates
QT5 brush adds 3rd finish coat -- account for additional coat time and interstage

proposed_new_keys.description: Small built-in openings (6-18" x 6-18") -- cubbies, shoe shelves, small niches
proposed_new_keys.justification: Generic built-in key from BuiltIns Quantification System v2.0. Distinct from closet-specific PS_OPENING_EA.CLOSET_SHELF.* keys.

proposed_new_keys.description: Medium built-in openings (18-36" x 12-30") -- standard bookshelf bays, typical built-in compartments
proposed_new_keys.justification: Most common tier for residential built-ins.

proposed_new_keys.description: Large built-in openings (36-60" x 18-42") -- wide media shelving, large compartments
proposed_new_keys.justification: Entertainment center and wide bookcase bays.

proposed_new_keys.description: XL built-in openings (60"+ x 30"+) -- oversized feature bays
proposed_new_keys.justification: Custom feature units, oversized media bays.

proposed_new_keys.description: Count of solid built-in doors and drawer fronts to remove, paint, and reinstall
proposed_new_keys.justification: Distinct from PS_META.EA.CABINET_DOORS (kitchen cabinets). Built-in doors vary widely in size and type.

proposed_new_keys.description: Count of hardware pieces (knobs, pulls, hinges, catches) to remove and reinstall
proposed_new_keys.justification: Labor driver for hardware removal/reinstall tasks. Typically 2-3 pieces per door.

adjacency_notes: Adjacent to wall_field on sides and top (linear edge, different_finish typically)
Adjacent to ceiling_field for floor-to-ceiling units (linear edge, different_finish)
Adjacent to floor at base (not_in_scope -- floor never painted)
Built-in enamel (satin/semi-gloss) typically differs from wall paint (flat/eggshell)
Caulk seals built-in-to-wall junction during prep -- no cut-in at paint time for brush work
Spray work requires wall masking at built-in-to-wall junction to prevent overspray

zones.notes: Drop cloth runners at base of built-in work area. Standard for brush millwork. Drips and sanding dust are primary concern.

zones.upgrade_scenario: Upgrades from floor_perimeter when spray method selected
zones.notes: Localized floor coverage around spray target. Built-ins are discrete -- not full room coverage. Rosin paper or canvas drops.
Wall masking near built-in-to-wall junction to prevent overspray. Paper + tape or masking film at junction.

zones.condition: application_method = spray AND ceiling fixtures near work area
zones.notes: Ceiling fixtures near spray work area. Plastic bag or film covers.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Built-in meets wall on sides and top. Different finish -- built-in enamel vs wall paint. Caulk seals gap during prep. Spray requires wall masking.
Floor-to-ceiling units meet ceiling. Different finish. Not all built-ins reach ceiling -- conditional on unit height. Spray requires ceiling masking.
Built-in base meets floor. Floor is never painted. Protection zone covers floor.

affected_conditions.notes: Floor protection only when finished floors present. NC may have subfloor during built-in painting.

affected_conditions.modifier_notes: OCC_SENSITIVE=1.30x, OCC_CREW_HANDLES=1.15x on protection tasks per Modifier_Registry
affected_conditions.notes: Rare in NC. Additional protection and daily reset when occupied.

affected_conditions.modifier_notes: Affects dry times, open time, and flow-out. Critical for waterborne alkyd (QT4+).
affected_conditions.notes: Refer to manufacturer PDS for temperature limits. Cold extends cure time for door reinstallation.

affected_conditions.modifier_notes: MDF edge sealing uses solvent-based products -- adequate ventilation required. Spray generates overspray. Poor ventilation extends dry times.
affected_conditions.notes: Particularly relevant for enclosed rooms (studies, libraries) where built-ins are common.

affected_conditions.modifier_notes: ACCESS modifier from BuiltIns Quantification System handles workspace restrictions
affected_conditions.notes: Tight spaces reduce production rate. Handled by PS_OPENING_MOD.ACCESS.

valid_input_states.rationale: Combined prime+paint spec for NC. SS_BARE requires full primer (substrate-driven). SS_PRIMED_FACTORY skips primer -- standard NC delivery is factory-primed.

output_state.rationale: Output state determined by sheen configuration. Satin is default for softer appearance.

adjacent_state_protection_analysis.rationale: Wall masking near built-in during spray to prevent overspray on finished walls. Unfinished walls need no protection. Brush application has no overspray risk.
Brush application has no overspray risk. Built-in-to-wall junction is caulked. No masking needed.
Ceiling masking for floor-to-ceiling units during spray. Only when ceiling is finished and built-in reaches ceiling.

assumptions.value: Closet shelving excluded -- routed to SF_CLOSET_SHELF_NC
assumptions.note: Clear scope separation: closet shelving is a simple dedicated spec

assumptions.value: Kitchen/bathroom cabinets excluded -- routed to SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT (future)
assumptions.note: Cabinets have unique protection requirements (countertops, appliances, backsplash)

assumptions.value: All removable solid doors and drawer fronts painted flat on sawhorses
assumptions.note: Horizontal painting for gravity-assisted leveling and drip prevention

assumptions.value: End panels, tops, face frames bundled with opening rates via DETAIL modifier for v1
assumptions.note: Optional separate PS keys for exterior surfaces deferred to v2 if production accuracy demands

uncertainties.description: No COMP_BUILTIN modifier exists in Modifier_Registry for adjacent wall/ceiling specs. COMP_CABINETS (1.50x) and COMP_CLOSET_SHELVING (1.50x) exist as precedent. May need proposal.
uncertainties.resolution: Flag for human review. Does not block this spec -- the modifier would apply to OTHER specs, not this one.

uncertainties.description: PS_OPENING_MOD.DEPTH, PS_OPENING_MOD.DETAIL, PS_OPENING_MOD.ACCESS are documented in BuiltIns Quantification System but may not be formally in PaintScope Quantity Key Catalog yet.
uncertainties.resolution: Include in proposed_new_keys if not in catalog. Pipeline should not block -- these are modifier enums, not quantity keys.

uncertainties.description: No established per-opening-tier production rates exist in doctrine. Closet shelf spec has rates but general built-ins may differ.
uncertainties.resolution: Estimation Engineer to establish rates using Millwork Doctrine SS7.1 trim rates as reference, adapted for opening-based work.
